title: Designing a CI/CD Pipeline
hint: Walk through source, build, test, deploy stages and gates, including blue/green and canary.

title: Kubernetes Pods, Deployments, and Services
hint: Cover the smallest deployable unit, controllers, networking abstractions, and rolling updates.

title: How do Docker Images & Layers work?
hint: Explain the union filesystem, layer caching, and how COPY/ADD/RUN instructions affect build time.
keyPoints: Layer caching and order of instructions

title: git rebase vs git merge
hint: Explain linear history via rebase vs preserving branch topology with merge, plus golden rule of rebase.
keyPoints: Rebase rewrites history; merge preserves it

title: Health Checks and Monitoring in Production
hint: Differentiate liveness vs readiness probes, alerting philosophies, and SLOs/error budgets.
keyPoints: Golden signals: latency, traffic, errors, saturation

title: Secrets Management for DevOps
hint: Vault, KMS, and secret rotation strategies. Why env vars in git are a problem.

title: Terraform Modules and State Management
hint: Explain remote state, locking, workspaces, and how to design reusable modules.

title: What is a Service Mesh?
hint: Sidecar proxies for service-to-service communication: retries, mTLS, traffic shifting.
